vow.text: In Kessig, Arlinn walked through a frozen village where sundown came sooner and sooner, and she sat with Agatha, whose husband had been killed, and promised to investigate the murders.
Deep within the Kessig forest, Wrenn uprooted herself from Six, who became an oak, and then wandered the forest following treesong toward a possible new partner.
There she met Teferi, who unmade a tangled time spell that had turned the path behind them into identical branching paths.
Arlinn's wolves sided with Tovolar, and Arlinn brought Kaya, Teferi and Chandra to Katilda's coven in the Kessig woods.
